hardRules: Do not duplicate a physical venue because the federal roster contains repeated rows.
Exclude travel-center gaming by default when it is not a separately promoted casino destination.
Treat Naskila Casino Leggett as a distinct current destination while the original Livingston facility also remains open.
Use current first-party address evidence when a newer public-facing address conflicts slightly with an older regulator roster, while retaining the regulator address in audit provenance.
Do not activate runtime records until property-specific coordinates and stable IDs pass duplicate QA.
